messages.message:
Patch Set 1:

(5 comments)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Experimental feature testing in progress, please pay attention to the comments

The one-line fix itself looks right: at this point `buf` is `lfsck_buf_get(env, ff, sizeof(struct filter_fid))`, so the old code read `lcm_entry_count` out of the upper 16 bits of `ff_parent.f_stripe_idx` (zero for any sane `ea_off`) and the component loop never ran. Concerns are inline, mostly about the commit message and about how this gets verified.

The repaired path has no test coverage. test_14b is the only sanity-lfsck case that runs layout LFSCK with `--delay-create-ostobj`, and it only builds plain `-c 1 -i 0` files; test_18d does create a PFL file with `-c -d` but asserts `repaired_dangling == 0`, since the orphan scan calls lfsck_layout_del_dangling_rec() before phase 2 ever looks at the record. Could a PFL variant of 14b be added, so there is a case that fails before this patch and passes after?

Patch Set 3:

(2 comments)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

The fix itself looks correct: buf points at info->lti_ff via lfsck_buf_get(env, ff, sizeof(struct filter_fid)), so lcm_entry_count was being read out of ff_parent.f_stripe_idx (offset 14 in both structs) and was always 0 for any sane ea_off.

The PFL + delayed-create path still has no test that would fail before this patch and pass after. test_14b is the only case that drives dangling repair to completion with -d, and it only creates plain -c 1 -i 0 files. test_18d does create a PFL file with -d, but it asserts repaired_dangling is 0 because the orphan scan deletes the dangling record first, so it never reaches this block. Adding a PFL guard file to test_14b (14a already does this for the non-delayed path) and checking that stat succeeds after the repair pass would cover it.

commit.subject: LU-17891 lfsck: fix lcm in __lfsck_layout_repair_dangling
commit.message:
LU-17891 lfsck: fix lcm in __lfsck_layout_repair_dangling

When LPF_DELAY_CREATE_OSTOBJ is enabled,
__lfsck_layout_repair_dangling() loads LOV EA into lovea.

For PFL files, it erroneously assigned:
    struct lov_comp_md_v1 *lcm = buf->lb_buf;

Since buf points to filter_fid instead of LOV EA, lcm->lcm_entry_count
read 0, skipping the component search loop and returning without creating the OST object for PFL files,  but still counting them.

Fix lcm to point to lovea->lb_buf so PFL components are searched and
repaired during phase 2 dangling reference repair.
